note: A second, declared scoring of test-2, as declaration-test-2.json requires for any change. Frozen before any system runs on test-2 with extents or the selection check. Committed and pushed before the run; totals are published whatever they are. Per-record outputs are never read.
question: On labels nobody has read, does the selection check (selection-1) raise the share of ready regions that are correct, and what does it cost in useful coverage?

systems.without_check: hybrid-1 (rules-6 first, llm-x2g2-qwen3.5-4b-q4km where the rules reach no candidate), reviewed + derived extents

inputs.annotations: Claude's (declaration-test-2-amendment-1.json): not independent of the systems; the derived extents and the selection check were also written by Claude, on dev data

how_it_runs: Outputs go to a new locked folder, eval/benchmark/test-2/reports-regions/. Standard output goes to log files there.

Without the check: `audit rules`; `audit llm --no-cache`; `audit hybrid --with-derived`; `audit score --worksheet eval/benchmark/test-2/scoring/worksheet-new.csv --with-derived --hybrid <out>/test-2-hybrid-1-extents-derived.json`.
With the check: the same four commands with --selection-check on rules and llm, and --with-derived --with-selection on hybrid and score (hybrid report test-2-hybrid-1-extents-derived-sel.json).
The LLM runs twice with the cache off (once per run); greedy decoding makes its completions the same in both.

measures.ready_regions: records whose proposal outcome is computed (ready_for_review)
measures.correct: of those, records with the right critical interpretation and an acceptable top candidate (the score report's precision)
measures.useful_coverage: correct ready regions over answerable records
measures.held_back: computed without the check but not with it, split into correct and wrong by the difference of the two runs' totals

expectation_stated_in_advance: Without the check, roughly 40-60% of ready regions correct (dev data: 47% Claude-annotated, 39% on dev-3 and dev-4). With it, roughly 60-70%, at a cost of about 3-5 points of useful coverage. No target applies to the check itself; this is a descriptive check of an in-sample rule on unread labels.
caveats: Claude annotated test-2 and wrote the rules, the derived extents and the check.
test-2 has been scored once already (declaration-test-2.json). Its totals did not shape the check, which was written from dev and validation records only.
Derived extents use current boundaries; correctness tests the interpretation and the reference, not the size of the radius.
run_rules: Each run happens once. A technical failure may be rerun under this declaration and is recorded.
Only totals are published, in eval/reports/test-2-regions.{md,json}.
